Name: FishReminder
Author: Mizzion
Description:
Allows the player to set up reminders that get mailed to them, to tell them which fish they still need to catch.

[size=2][color=#ff0000]Please run the game atleast once, so that the config file can be generated.[/color][/size]


[b]Config Options[/b]:
[i]SendReminderMailDaily[/i] - You will be sent a reminder letter each day.
[i]SendReminderMailWeekly[/i] - You will be sent a reminder letter each Monday.
[i]SendReminderMailMonthly[/i] - You will be sent a reminder letter at the start of the season.

You can set any or all of those to true.

Manifest.Name: FishReminder
Manifest.Description: Tells the players which fish they still need to catch based on season.
